limitations.only_the_net_contrast_is_reported: Only the net contrast is reported. The gross capture leg admits a choice of weighting and of which cells to include, and that choice was not free, so no p-value is reported for it. The net specification was fixed before these numbers were read.
limitations.null_carries_cross_coin_dependence_by_co: The null applies one shared sign per date, which carries whatever same-day dependence exists across coins into the null by construction, so nothing about that dependence is estimated, imputed or repaired. An alternative route through a 66-pair correlation matrix left two thirds of the pairs with insufficient overlap, and filling those with zeros, which asserts independence, produced a spuriously significant result.
limitations.single_venue: Bybit only. The regime cells are cut from the Bybit panel.

conditioning.block_definition: UTC hour of the fill in one of three eight-hour session blocks: asia 00 to 07, europe 08 to 15, us 16 to 23
conditioning.regime_definition: tercile of realised volatility over the 30 minutes ending at each fill, from mids strictly before it
conditioning.cutoff_rule: each date takes cutoffs from fills on strictly earlier dates alone; dates without enough history are labelled -1 and dropped rather than defaulted into the middle tercile
caveats: the stress share is not pinned at a third and drifts across the sample, so calm and stress cells differ in date composition as well as coin composition
pooled cutoffs restricted to these same dates is the control that would separate the label channel from the sample channel, and it is not run here
conditioning.dropped_prefix_is_carried_not_computed: dropped_prefix_share_of_tape and the composition beside it are carried from the upstream measurement as literals. The shipped panel holds only the cells that survived the cut, so neither is derivable from it and a rebuild re-emits them unchanged rather than checking them.
